errors.evidence: This description of the light blue line ('mit Kind(ern) unter 14') is incorrect. The line does not start fluctuating in the 75-80% range from age 30. Instead, it continues to rise steeply from about 62% at age 30 to a peak of about 85% at age 43, before declining slightly.
